```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(lme4)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(shiny)
library(gganimate)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(ggmap)
library(osmdata)
```

```{r}
#read in the dataset
chempop <- read.csv(here("data", "Chempop", "updated chempop", "river_health_atlas_analysis_ready.csv"))

#colnames(chempop)

```

```{r}
chempop <- chempop %>%
  select(assemblage, sample_id, sample_date, sample_year, site_id, bio_site_id, site_label, reporting_area, sample_method, analysis_id,  easting, northing, longitude, latitude, taxon_richness,  zinc_total_mean_6mo, copper_total_mean_6mo) %>% #select the columns that i want
  mutate(sample_date = as.Date(sample_date)) %>% #make sure date is stored as a date
  filter(sample_date >= as.Date("2000-01-01")) #filter for dates from 2000 onwards

chempop <- chempop %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("easting", "northing"), #change eastings and northings into a coordinate reference system
    crs = 27700
  ) %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>% #for each chemical, if the concentration is outside the first 95% of that chemical, then give it a value of NA. this is because I want to focus on the first 95% of each chemical, because the outlier values are really difficult to plot and deal with.
mutate(

    zinc_total_mean_6mo = if_else(
      zinc_total_mean_6mo >
        quantile(
          zinc_total_mean_6mo,
          0.95,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
      NA_real_,
      zinc_total_mean_6mo
    ),

    copper_total_mean_6mo = if_else(
      copper_total_mean_6mo >
        quantile(
          copper_total_mean_6mo,
          0.95,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
      NA_real_,
      copper_total_mean_6mo
    ))
```

```{r}
chempop_filtered <- chempop %>% 
  #filter(
   # zinc_total_mean_6mo <= quantile(zinc_total_mean_6mo, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    #copper_total_mean_6mo <= quantile(copper_total_mean_6mo, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% #focus on the first 95% of data to make it easier to plot
  select(assemblage, sample_id, sample_date, sample_year, site_id, geometry, zinc_total_mean_6mo, copper_total_mean_6mo) %>%
  filter(
    !(is.na(zinc_total_mean_6mo) &
      is.na(copper_total_mean_6mo)))


#calculate the mean concentration for each site for each year
chempop_summaries <- chempop_filtered %>%
  group_by(sample_year, site_id) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_zinc = mean(zinc_total_mean_6mo, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_copper = mean(copper_total_mean_6mo, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#one site in 2023 is stored as MULTIPOINT instead of POINT and this causes problems later. this fixes it:
chempop_summaries <- chempop_summaries %>%
  st_cast("POINT")
```

```{r}
#filter for just the year 2000, for now
chempop_2000 <- chempop_summaries %>%
  filter(sample_year == "2000")

#transform to british national grid
chempop_2000_bng <- chempop_2000 %>%
  st_transform(27700)

#create a hexagonal grid of the bng dataset
hex_grid <- st_make_grid(
  chempop_2000_bng,
  cellsize = 20000, #20km hexagons
  square = FALSE
) %>%
  st_as_sf()

#join the hexagon grid onto the chempop bng dataset
chempop_hex <- st_join(
  chempop_2000_bng,
  hex_grid,
  join = st_within
)

#give heat hexagon an id based on the row number
hex_grid <- hex_grid %>%
  mutate(hex_id = row_number())

#join the points
chempop_hex <- st_join(
  chempop_2000_bng,
  hex_grid,
  join = st_within
)

#summarise
hex_summary <- chempop_hex %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(hex_id) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_zinc = mean(
      mean_zinc,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_points = n()
  )

#join the means back onto the hexagons
hex_grid_summary <- hex_grid %>%
  left_join(
    hex_summary,
    by = "hex_id"
  )
```

```{r}
#plot the hexbin map
ggplot() +

  geom_sf(
    data = hex_grid_summary,
    aes(fill = mean_zinc),
    colour = NA
  ) +

  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "Mean zinc\nconcentration",
    na.value = "white"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +

  labs(
    title = "Mean zinc concentration by hexagonal grid cell"
  )
```
